tools.name: sold_comps
tools.description:
What an item actually sold for on Poshmark: median sold price, typical range (p10-p90), days to sell,
        what the seller keeps after fees, price by condition, a confidence rating, and the matching sales.
        Call it for one item at a time; if it reports busy, wait the given number of second

tools.name: buy_or_pass
tools.description:
Whether an item is worth buying at a given cost to resell on Poshmark: buy, maybe or pass with the
        reason, judged from its clean sold comps after Poshmark's fee.
        Call it for one item at a time; if it reports busy, wait the given number of seconds and call again.

        query: brand

tools.name: value_donation_list
tools.description:
Fair-market values for a whole donation list (clothing, shoes, bags and household
        goods: kitchen, home, electronics, media, toys, baby gear, pets, beauty), each item with the Poshmark sales
        behind it, a list total and a dated method paragraph the donor can keep with their
        rec

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sold_comps" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
